description: Add configuration settings, integrate ProviderManager into API dependencies (safe backward-compatible update preserving DevelopmentProvider as default), write comprehensive deterministic tests (mocked HTTP with respx or httpx MockTransport, no real internet), run all existing tests to ensure no regressions, and document in docs/PROGRESS.md. Tests must cover: provider normalization with source metadata, HTTP timeout/error handling, ProviderManager routing, failover behavior, no-failover-on-missing-optional-field, source-of-truth enforcement, and cache TTL.
steps: Update backend/app/config.py Settings class. Add fields: ryzellx_base_url: str = 'http://localhost:8080' (safe default for local development); fotmob_base_url: str = 'https://www.fotmob.com'; openligadb_base_url: str = 'https://api.openligadb.de'; provider_timeout_seconds: float = 10.0; provider_retry_count: int = 2; live_provider_order: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ['fotmob', 'ryzellx', 'openligadb']); default_provider_order: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ['ryzellx', 'openligadb']); use_real_providers: bool = False (False = use DevelopmentProvider; True = use ProviderManager). Add comments explaining safe defaults and zero-budget architecture (no API keys required).

Update backend/app/api/dependencies.py get_data_provider() function. Read settings.use_real_providers. If False, yield DevelopmentProvider() as before (backward-compatible default). If True, instantiate ProviderCache, RyzellxFootballProvider(base_url=settings.ryzellx_base_url, timeout_seconds=settings.provider_timeout_seconds, retry_count=settings.provider_retry_count, cache=cache), FotMobFootballProvider(similar args), OpenLigaDBFootballProvider(similar args), ProviderManager(ryzellx, fotmob, openligadb, cache), then yield a ProviderManagerAdapter that wraps ProviderManager and implements the existing FootballDataProvider interface (sync methods calling asyncio.run(provider_manager.async_method(...))). IMPORTANT: Do NOT modify matches.py endpoints or change API response contracts. The adapter ensures existing endpoint code continues working unchanged.

Create backend/app/providers/adapter.py with ProviderManagerAdapter class. Implement FootballDataProvider interface (sync methods) by wrapping ProviderManager async methods with asyncio.run(). Map ProviderMatch -> Match, ProviderTeam -> Team, etc. Add is_development_data() -> False. Add get_provider_name() -> f'ProviderManager ({metadata['selected_provider']})'.

Create comprehensive test file backend/tests/test_providers_multi.py. Use pytest with httpx mocking (respx library if available, else httpx MockTransport). NEVER hit real internet. Test categories: (1) Exceptions: instantiate and verify each ProviderError subclass carries provider_name, operation, message. (2) Models: instantiate each ProviderXxx model with source metadata, verify all fields, verify Optional fields accept None. (3) Cache: test ProviderCache.get/set with TTL expiry, thread safety (use threading to test concurrent access). (4) Ryzellx: mock httpx responses for each endpoint, verify normalization to ProviderMatch/ProviderTeam/etc., verify source metadata (provider='ryzellx', fetched_at, etc.), test timeout (mock timeout exception -> ProviderTimeoutError), test HTTP 404 -> ProviderNotFoundError, test HTTP 500 with retry -> ProviderHTTPError, test invalid JSON -> ProviderInvalidDataError, verify xG=None when not in response (no invented values). (5) FotMob: similar tests for daily matches, match detail, live matches endpoints. (6) OpenLigaDB: test match normalization with xG=None, stats=None (verify no invented values). (7) ProviderManager: test routing (NORMAL uses Ryzellx first, LIVE uses FotMob first), test fallback (mock Ryzellx timeout, verify OpenLigaDB is tried), test NO fallback when xG=None (mock Ryzellx returning match with xG=None, verify ProviderManager returns that match without trying fallback), test metadata (selected_provider, attempted_providers, fallback_used fields).
Run pytest backend/tests/test_providers_multi.py -v. Fix all failures. Ensure tests are deterministic (same result every run, no flakiness).

Run pytest backend/tests/ -v to verify all existing tests still pass (no regressions). If any fail, diagnose and fix. Common issue: tests may need adjustments if domain models changed, but existing tests should mostly pass unchanged because DevelopmentProvider is still the default (use_real_providers=False).

Update docs/PROGRESS.md. Append entry: '## Multi-Provider Football Data Abstraction

**Date:** {current_date}

**Implemented:**
- Provider-independent normalized models (ProviderMatch, ProviderTeam, ProviderPlayer, etc.) with source metadata (provider, source_id, fetched_at, is_live, data_freshness_seconds)
- Structured provider exceptions (ProviderError, ProviderTimeoutError, ProviderHTTPError, ProviderInvalidDataError, ProviderNotFoundError)
- Simple in-memory TTL cache (ProviderCache) with thread safety
- RyzellxFootballProvider (PRIMARY provider): async httpx client, all documented endpoints, normalization, retry logic, cache integration
- FotMobFootballProvider (LIVE/FAST provider, unofficial): daily matches, match details, live data — conservative request patterns, no bypasses
- OpenLigaDBFootballProvider (INDEPENDENT FALLBACK): leagues, matches, standings — explicitly does NOT provide xG/advanced stats (None for unavailable fields)
- ProviderManager with routing policy: NORMAL [Ryzellx, OpenLigaDB]; LIVE [FotMob, Ryzellx, OpenLigaDB]; MATCH_DETAIL [Ryzellx, FotMob, OpenLigaDB]
- SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RULE enforced: each response from ONE provider, never hybrid data
- Failover on timeout/HTTP error/invalid data, NOT on missing optional field (xG=None is valid)
- Configuration: ryzellx_base_url, fotmob_base_url, openligadb_base_url, provider_timeout_seconds, provider_retry_count, use_real_providers (default False = DevelopmentProvider)
- API integration: ProviderManagerAdapter wraps async ProviderManager for sync FootballDataProvider interface — backward-compatible, no endpoint changes
- Comprehensive tests: 100% mocked HTTP (no real internet), deterministic, covers normalization, error handling, routing, failover, source-of-truth

**Provider Roles:**
- Ryzellx: PRIMARY for matches, fixtures, results, match detail, teams, players, leagues, standings, xG/stats when available
- FotMob: LIVE/FAST for real-time match data (unofficial integration)
- OpenLigaDB: INDEPENDENT FALLBACK for German leagues, basic match data (no xG)

**Failover Behavior:**
- Triggers: timeout, HTTP 4xx/5xx, invalid JSON, connection error
- Does NOT trigger on missing optional field (xG=None keeps primary provider as source)

**Configuration Variables:**
- RYZELLX_BASE_URL (default: http://localhost:8080)
- FOTMOB_BASE_URL (default: https://www.fotmob.com)
- OPENLIGADB_BASE_URL (default: https://api.openligadb.de)
- PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default: 10.0)
- PROVIDER_RETRY_COUNT (default: 2)
- USE_REAL_PROVIDERS (default: False — DevelopmentProvider remains default)

**Test Results:**
- pytest backend/tests/test_providers_multi.py: {insert_result}
- pytest backend/tests/: {insert_result}
- All tests deterministic, no real internet requests

**Next Steps:**
- Set USE_REAL_PROVIDERS=True and configure provider base URLs when ready to use real data
- Monitor provider performance and cache hit rates
- Add provider metrics/observability if needed
- Consider rate limiting for FotMob (unofficial integration)'
acceptance_criteria: config.py Settings includes all new provider config fields with safe defaults
dependencies.py get_data_provider() respects use_real_providers flag (False = DevelopmentProvider, True = ProviderManagerAdapter wrapping ProviderManager)
ProviderManagerAdapter implements FootballDataProvider interface, maps ProviderXxx -> domain models, wraps async calls with asyncio.run()

test_providers_multi.py covers: exceptions, models, cache, Ryzellx (normalization, errors, cache), FotMob (normalization, errors), OpenLigaDB (normalization, no xG), ProviderManager (routing, failover, no-failover-on-missing-xG, source-of-truth, metadata)
All tests use mocked HTTP (respx or httpx MockTransport), NEVER real internet
verification: Run: pytest backend/tests/ -v (expect all pass, no regressions)
Verify: DevelopmentProvider still works (use_real_providers=False by default)
